# Pixel Cinema Seat Picker

A simple offline cinema seat picker built with HTML, CSS, and plain JavaScript. No dependencies, no network requests.

## Features

- 5 rows (A–E) × 8 seats (1–8) grid
- Some seats are pre-marked as taken and cannot be selected
- Click or tap free seats to select/deselect
- Selected seats shown as labels (e.g., `B4, B5`)
- Total price calculated at $9 per seat
- Clear selection button
- Keyboard accessible with visible focus states
- Responsive layout works from 360px wide

## Run

Open `index.html` in any modern browser. No server or build step required.

## Files

- `index.html` – structure
- `style.css` – styling
- `app.js` – seat logic
